label: stock total return from close t+1 to close t+6 minus vwretd compounded over t+2..t+6
ordinary_label_policy: Require executable entry and exit closes; verified P* spans may bridge only entirely within the holding interval
delist_policy: Strict main label is missing; known NA-flagged CIZ delisting returns produce a separately named frozen-proceeds proxy, never actual cash settlement
unresolved_returns: MV/DG/DM/DP/GP and unverified spans remain missing; never zero or blanket -100%
feature_policy: Raw causal features; strict complete rolling windows; no imputation, winsorization, scaling or feature selection before training
split_purge: Label end must be inside the signal-date split. After tuning, refit eligibility is separately available through 2021-12-31.
